title: Intake missing[] panel, csr alias, claims PII for Location, scheduler sweep, safe handlers
story: As a CSR I see which required questions remain; as a security owner location data is encrypted; as an operator event handlers never fail on missing claims.
acceptance: IntakeStep returned by intake service includes missing: [{questionId, text}] listing required (incl. requiredIf-resolved) questions not yet answered, localized to session locale; empty array when none; test in tests/unit/intake/missing.test.js
startSession accepts channel 'csr' and normalizes to 'csr_phone' (stored session and question-set lookup use csr_phone); test covers alias and unchanged canonical values

claims PII_PATHS.lossEvent includes location.description and location.geo; geo (object) round-trips through encrypt/decrypt, is stored encrypted, and never appears in events/audit; tests in tests/unit/claims/pii.test.mjs and service.test.mjs
claims timer sweep uses ctx.scheduler.every when ctx.scheduler exists, else setInterval; both paths tested in tests/unit/claims/timers.test.mjs with a fake scheduler; stop/teardown cancels either
claims and intake event handlers for a missing claim log (ctx.log) and return without throwing; tests assert applyEvent/applyTimerEvent and intake handlers resolve for unknown claim ids
Only the team's own tests run green: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/intake tests/unit/claims
brief: Work in 4 small parts. (1) Intake: in src/modules/intake/service.js and questions.js, find where the IntakeStep is built (after answering/getStep). Compute missing from the visible question list: questions with required true or requiredIf evaluating true (reuse rules.evaluateCondition as the engine already does, plus intake-stage require_question rules) that have no answer. Return {questionId, text} using the localized text the step already uses. Add to routes response untouched since it serializes the step. (2) Channel alias: normalize at the top of startSession (const CHANNEL_ALIASES = {csr:'csr_phone'}) before the lobCfg.channels check and getQuestionSet call. (3) Claims pii.mjs: add 'location.description' and 'location.geo' to PII_PATHS.lossEvent. wrap() already JSON-stringifies so objects work; verify mapPii handles object values and that isEncrypted guard remains. Check service.mjs for places that build event payloads/audit details from lossEvent and ensure the redact path covers the new fields; check any read path that returns decrypted loss to authorized callers. Existing rows with plaintext must still read (unwrap passes non-encrypted through). (4) Timers/index.mjs line ~54: if (ctx.scheduler?.every) use it with the same interval and handler, keep the returned handle/cancel for shutdown; else setInterval (unref it). Check the scheduler contract in architecture/core-runtime-api.md for the exact signature and cancel return. (5) Handlers: wrap lookups in applyEvent/applyTimerEvent and intake bus handlers; if claim not found, ctx.log.warn and return undefined; do not catch unrelated errors. Pitfall: do not edit package.json; use local fakes for scheduler and crypto in tests (see tests/unit/claims/helpers.mjs, tests/unit/intake/fakes.mjs). Report any contract gaps via architecture hub contract-change.
valueDrivers: Faster CSR handling via required-items panel

verdicts.reason: All 6 criteria verified; 54 unit tests pass; no new regressions attributable to this ticket (openapi drift failure involves routes from other teams)
